met_criteria: A multi-day simulation (minimum 10 consecutive world days, days 3-12) is run using the real world generator and T4 activation rate is confirmed to be 0.0 — every day emits an audit record with activated=False
Blocker 1 identified: get_world_snapshot in back/app/world/generator.py never sets social_event on the returned WorldSnapshot — field is always None
Blocker 2 identified: _detect_qualifying_t4_social_event in tick_bridge.py returns None every day because world.social_event is None
Blocker 3 identified: build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick always returns positive-valence/mild_increase signal — negative branch structurally unreachable
Blocker 4 identified: _t4_wake_chain_gate_open requires valence==negative and trust_shift in (mild_decrease, strong_decrease), never satisfied
Blocker 5 identified: bootstrapping deadlock — no relational residual ever created, _adjust_t4 never called with non-None residual
Audit report states exact bootstrapping deadlock explanation (circular dependency described in Blocker 5 section)
Audit output is structured and referenceable — docs/p32_t4_blocker_audit.md with summary table, activation metrics, and per-blocker file/line references
All existing tests continue to pass after the audit script and report are added
non_blocking_suggestions: The test uses unittest.mock.patch to suppress the LLM router — this is appropriate and prevents API calls, but the patch target path ('app.engines.tick_bridge._appraisal_router.route') should remain consistent if the module is refactored.

The inline code snippets in the audit report (e.g., the _detect_qualifying_t4_social_event body shown in Blocker 2) are paraphrased rather than exact source quotes — acceptable for a diagnostic report but worth noting for traceability.
notes: Both deliverables (back/tests/test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py and docs/p32_t4_blocker_audit.md) are present as untracked files — no existing files were modified.
